thread:
sam: :rotating_light: Quick incident broadcast — Hosted inference in us-east1 is seeing sustained enqueue delays and elevated latencies due to an ingress queue linearization bug. Customers may see 502/504 or very slow responses for longer contexts. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2195012345

mina: Thanks Sam. Confirming impact: multiple mid-size customers seeing >10s p95 and some 5xxs. Traces show requests stuck in the enqueue stage for ~8-20s before workers pick them up.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2195012345 — tag: hosted, us-east1, customer-impact. Runbook: https://git.redwood.ai/incidents/runbooks/ingress-queue-linearization

sam: Mitigations in flight: 1) temporary ingress throttling by route to shed excess headroom; 2) automated model-swap to smaller sequence-optimized variants for high-latency tenants; 3) rebalancer toggle to drain overloaded routers. Deploy for rebalancer toggle is rolling now (PR #8421).

jordan: Rebalancer toggle applied to 40% of routers at 12:07 UTC. Early signal: queue depth dropped ~30% on those routers. P95 latency down from 11.2s -> 6.8s on toggled routers.

liz: I pushed a hotfix to the enqueue loop that removes a pathological lock path, build 0.39.7, currently canarying on 6 routers. Logs: ```2026-03-23T12:09:31Z enqueue: freed linearization token for request=abc123 host=us-east1```

mina: Can we ask SRE to avoid restarting any producer pods until the canary finishes? Restarts re-introduce transient spikes. @jordan @liz please coordinate.

jordan: Ack — no restarts unless Sev escalates. Will monitor memory and cpu while canary rolls.

ops-bot: Update INC-2195012345: mitigation applied: ingress throttling + model-swap + rebalancer toggle. Customer-facing latency decreased but errors still intermittent. Next steps: finish canary, roll fix fully, run small workload soak, then revert throttles.

amy-product: Any customer comms required now? We should surface this to affected accounts with ETA for full resolution. Drafting a short note and will loop in account owners.

sam: Yes please — include workaround: switch to smaller model family or reduce max_tokens for lower tail latency. Example snippet: `model="redwood-small-v2" max_tokens=512`.

liz: Canary hit completed at 12:24 UTC with no regressions. Planning full rollout in 5m.

jordan: Full rollout started 12:30 UTC. Monitoring dashboards: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/ingress-queues/us-east1-overview

ops-bot: Final update at 12:45 UTC: patch fully rolled out. Throttles removed. p95 latency back to baseline for most tenants. Closing the active mitigation phase; postmortem scheduled tomorrow 15:00 UTC in #postmortems.

sam: :white_check_mark: Thanks everyone. If you see residual errors, add traces to the incident thread and tag me. Postmortem owners: mina + liz.

mina: Adding initial notes for the postmortem in the doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/2195012345/postmortem

jordan: Closing watch — will hand to oncall for follow-up. Thanks!
